_comment: Beam cap C, off-screen beams (kits/w60_beamcap.mjs, pilot pilots/w60_bc_c.json): a Shuttle at rest by Kit Sub Port, its shän BeamPos 360 px ahead; F12 on; `w` selects wëap 338 BC Hidden; 25 Ctrl taps 0.25 s apart fire its 20-beam burst from 360 px ahead (off the play area, blue); then Space held 18 s fires the green spokes (wëap 336); then the ship turns Left 3 s and Right 3 s (the hidden beams show through the diagonals). Count the spokes born before the births stop: 64 if off-screen beams do not count, 44 if they do.
